verdict.rationale: Slate is a coding agent, so an ecosystem of partner-built agent apps is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows no marketplace, partner program, or way to plug third-party agent apps into workflows. Skills are markdown instruction packages, and Claude Code skill-directory compatibility and built-in subagent orchestration are adjacent features, not integration of partner-built agent apps.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can integrate third-party partner-built agent apps into my workflows
